Germany will be looking to put themselves in the strongest possible position ahead of a potential Group A2 decider against the Netherlands next week when they travel to Belgrade to face Serbia on Friday at 20:45 in their penultimate 2026/27 UEFA Nations League group-stage fixture.

The two teams met last month, with Germany taking a 2-0 win at home thanks to goals from Tom Bischof and Florian Wirtz.

data.title: Serbia vs Germany: How to watch, Live Stream, TV Channel and Time for a UEFA Nations League game on November 13, 2026 -
data.content:
For Germany, a win in Belgrade would keep their quarter-final hopes alive before their final group match against the Netherlands on November 16. Jurgen Klopp‘s team opened the campaign with a 1-1 draw against the Dutch, lost 1-0 to Greece, beat Serbia 2-0 at home and then drew 0-0 with Greece. The first meeting with Serbia in Munich was decided by goals from Florian Wirtz and Tom Bischof.

Advertisement [...] Serbia and Germany meet in Matchday 5 of UEFA Nations League Group A2, with very different objectives entering the final two fixtures. Germany are third with five points from four matches, three behind co-leaders Netherlands and Greece, while Serbia sit last without a point after losing all four of their opening games. The top two teams advance to the quarter-finals, while the bottom side in each League A group is automatically relegated. [...] Advertisement

Serbia, meanwhile, are in danger of dropping out of League A. Another defeat would confirm that they finish bottom of Group A2 before their final match against Greece. Coach Veljko Paunovic has called up Aleksandar Mitrovic and Dusan Vlahovic again after both forwards missed Serbia’s first four group games. However, midfielders Nemanja Maksimovic and Sasa Lukic are suspended for the Germany match after accumulating yellow cards.
